title: Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr (al-Durar)
transliterated_title: Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr (al-Durar), Commentary on the Tāʾiyya al-Kubrā of Ibn al-Fāriḍ
genre: anthology-as-commentary on Ibn al-Fāriḍ's Tāʾiyya al-Kubrā; Arabic version and Persian translation

date.basis: Melvin-Koushki states completion in Dhū l-Ḥijja 806/June 1404, presumably in Cairo; the entry cites no colophon for the date. The Majlis copy is dated 8 Ramaḍān 828/24 July 1425. The commentary is said to reference the Mafāḥiṣ (823/1420) and the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ (814/1411), which sits uneasily with 806.

occasion: written at the request of friends, first in Arabic and then translated into Persian
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. '-1b-51b' (as printed; the original Arabic version is in its margins); MS 5423 ff. 2b-124a (842/1439); MS Sipahsālār 2930/11 ff. 281b-386a (845/1441); 16 copies listed.
majlis_folios: ff. -1b-51b (as printed, sic; the Arabic version is in the margins)
summary: A popular mystical-philosophical commentary on Ibn al-Fāriḍ's Tāʾiyya al-Kubrā, treating each verse allusively with Arabic and Persian poetry, written first in Arabic and then in Persian; one of the major works.
edition_note: Persian: ed. Akram Jūdī-Niʿmatī, Tehran 2005 (the SND edition); partial Arabic: ed. Majīd Hādīzāda, Tehran 2007.
